comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: I’d argue Lesotho’s isolation is both its greatest strength and its biggest challenge. Would you agree?

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: A country completely surrounded by South Africa, landlocked, and its LOWEST point is over 1,400m above sea level! In the age of technology, herd boys wearing traditional Basotho blankets ride horses across snow-capped mountains. This looks exactly like a land forgotten by time. What surprised you the most about Lesotho? 🇱🇸🏔

comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: The concept of Lesotho being the only country entirely above 1,000 meters—and exporting its mountain water as 'white gold' to the country that surrounds it—is such a fascinating geographical dynamic
